response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM c), g AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM c WHERE a > (SELECT v FROM o)), f AS (SELECT a FROM c WHERE a > (SELECT v FROM g)) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(a - (SELECT v FROM o)) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(a - (SELECT v FROM g)) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM f
